adaptation.enabled_hint: Decide whether to skip this song next time from how it was played in this playlist.

settings.sub: Changes apply immediately; there is no Save button.
settings.theme_hint: Light or dark only; the system preference is used once on the first run.
about.title: About
about.data_dir_hint: Where the library, playlists, stats and settings live.
about.data_dir_saved: Saved: {path}. The old folder is moved there on the next start.
about.readme_hint: Open the manual in the current language.
about.reset_hint: Restore language, appearance and every setting to factory defaults. The library is not affected.
about.reset_confirm: Reset all settings? Language and appearance will also be reset. The library, playlists and stats are not affected.
settings.language_hint: Switching takes effect immediately: labels and the window title change together.
settings.adaptation_hint: Used when a playlist does not override a value; overrides live in the playlist detail.
settings.record_total_plays_hint: Counted across the whole library and independent of each playlist's adaptation switch. A play counts once it reaches the threshold of the current context: the playlist's own threshold inside a playlist, the global one in single-song loop.
settings.logs_hint: All three programs share these log settings and keep writing to the same file. The manager applies them at once; the two players pick them up on their next start.
settings.log_level_hint: How much is recorded. DEBUG writes every ignored detail; turn it on only while troubleshooting.
settings.log_cleanup_hint: Deletes log files older than the retention period at startup; turn it off to keep them all.
settings.log_retention_days_hint: How long logs are kept, 30 days by default. Has no effect while the switch above is off.
settings.import_dir_hint: The file dialog starts here; leave empty to start in the program folder.
settings.clean_audio_hint: Re-mux with FFmpeg and drop metadata, so the same song dedupes across tagged copies.
settings.simple_hint: The simple player starts the default playlist immediately and has no settings of its own.
settings.simple_order_hint: Shuffle plays each song once per round; list loop follows the playlist order.
settings.default_playlist_hint: The simple player always plays this playlist. It is built in and cannot be deleted.
settings.volume_hint: Starting volume; changes made inside the player are remembered.
settings.player_order_hint: Starting play mode; it can be switched inside the player.
settings.remember_progress_hint: Reopen the player at the last playlist and position, paused.
settings.check_hint: The quick check does not read audio; the deep check recomputes every MD5 and verifies bitrates with ffprobe.
settings.clean_orphans_hint: Files in assets with no library record are sent to the Recycle Bin.
settings.clean_orphans_confirm: Send every audio file without a library record to the Recycle Bin?
settings.clear_stats_hint: Deletes the adaptive records of every playlist. This cannot be undone; total play counts are kept.
settings.clear_stats_confirm: Clear the adaptive statistics of every playlist? This cannot be undone; total play counts are kept.
settings.dirs_hint: When troubleshooting, the log folder is usually the first stop.
adaptation.song_scope_hint: Adaptive settings are per playlist; this card shows the default playlist.
adaptation.not_in_default: This song is not in the default playlist, so it has no adaptive data.

author.empty_hint: “Title - Artist” in a filename creates the artist automatically; you can also add one by hand.
